course.title: Course requirements — what you must be able to do
course.intro: Treat Classical AI: Search, Reasoning & Planning like exam preparation: the requirements below describe what you should be able to demonstrate. They do not give you solution code.
plainEnglish: This course is training you to use Classical AI: Search, Reasoning & Planning ideas on new problems, not just recognize code or answers you have already seen.
You should finish able to read a requirement, describe the behavior it needs in ordinary language, and then choose the code or method yourself.

For each lesson, you must be able to state what the lesson is teaching and demonstrate the idea on a small new case.

For each knowledge check, you must be able to justify the selected answer using a course rule or concept instead of guessing.
